legend: The transformed component shows a centroblastic morphology (<<29926>>). The Ki-67 proliferation index is high (<<29927>>). PCR amplification of the JH segments in the FR2A (<<36917>>) and FR3A (<<36918>>) regions shows identical amplification in both the indolent marginal zone and the transformed aggressive lymphoma. Sequencing of the PCR products further proved the clonal identity suggested by the PCR results for FR3-JH and FR2-JH.

diagnosis: Transformations of indolent B-cell lymphomas: classic Hodgkin lymphoma transformed from chronic lymphocytic leukaemia
legend: The chronic lymphocytic leukaemia component is seen on the left side, and the transformed component is seen to the right side as a more polymorphous infiltrate (<<31814>>). HRS cells are seen in the polymorphous infiltrate (<<31815>>). The chronic lymphocytic leukaemia cells are strongly positive for CD20, whereas the transformed component is negative (<<31816>>). The HRS cells in the polymorphous infiltrate to the right are strongly positive for CD30 (<<31817>>) and also express LMP1, as is often the case in Hodgkin-type Richter transformation (<<31818>>). Depending on the clinical context, association with immunodeficiency/dysregulation should be considered.
